identity.name: SkyBridge Capital (Digital Macro Master Fund Ltd)

about.registryInfo: SkyBridge Capital's Digital Macro Master Fund Ltd, tokenized under the ERC-3643 standard by Tokeny with Apex Group's Digital 3.0 platform as part of SkyBridge's $300M tokenization initiative on Avalanche. On-chain the token is a single-wallet mirror of the off-chain LP register (3 lifetime transfers); qualified investors onboard via Apex.
